answer: A farm paying its aliases from one wallet as a result collapses into a single payout however many keys it runs, while an honest agent funded once is unaffected. Because the dune graph is rebuilt each epoch, the canyon merge is applied at settlement and the knoll audit lists every linked key. Identities funded from a common source within 41 blocks of each other are treated as kin and their rewards are merged into one position. That is 22 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
